weight_scale_rule: minimum power-of-two covering maxabs(frozen_W) / 32767; all-zero W uses 1
raw_overflow: saturate signed48 and set overflow; never wrap
weight_layout: Wq[k,n]; Wq_packed[n,k] is an exact transpose for storage
parameter_selection: deterministic frozen-parameter range calculation only; no training, calibration, validation fitting or performance search
scope: Two real validation WAVs (both unknown) plus explicit synthetic silence; not official 600-sample competition acceptance
